visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two rounded blocks linked by a short bar; both blocks are shorter and wider than the reviewed drawing (16 x 28, was 14 x 36), keeping r4 rounded corners.
omissions: The reference's blocks are square; the widest SOLO48 keyshape (HRECT_M) still needs 28 units of height, so the blocks are 16 x 28, the shortest-and-widest proportion available. A circle keyshape cannot hold straight outer sides.
drawing_plan: HRECT_M: blocks x4..20 and x28..44, y10..38, r4 corners; link (20,24)-(28,24).
